blocks.text: Today’s headlines: Rodrigo Duterte, Baste Duterte, Mark Zuckerberg
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: ICC orders Rodrigo Duterte’s continued detention

blocks.text: The International Criminal Court Trial Chamber III orders the continued detention of former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte at The Hague, Netherlands.

items: Prosecution to call Sebastian Duterte to witness stand in VP Sara’s trial

blocks.text: The prosecution in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial will call her brother, Davao City Mayor Sebastian Duterte, to the witness stand.

items: House summons Meta’s Zuckerberg over child safety, defers action on 2027 DICT budget

blocks.text: The House of Representatives summons Meta Platforms CEO Mark Zuckerberg. This over child safety concerns and how the platform can improve online safety for Filipino users.

items: Divine Adili’s parents accept teammates’ account of son’s death: ‘We have known the truth’

blocks.text: The parents of late Ateneo big man Divine Adili say they have now known the “truth” about their son’s death after attending the Blue Eagles’ opening for their UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball campaign.

items: Team Japan forced to look at alternate accommodation options at home Asian Games

blocks.text: Accommodation issues continue to plague the lead-up to the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games as host team Japan is forced to look at alternative arrangements after cases in which male and female athletes were allocated shared rooms. – Rappler.com
